description: React component for managing price data reloads, including manual refresh, scheduling periodic reloads, and viewing reload status.

methods.name: fetchReloadStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current reload status from the backend and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleHardRefresh
methods.description: Triggers an immediate price data reload and updates the status upon success.

methods.name: handleScheduleReload
methods.description: Schedules periodic reloads based on user input.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats a date/time string into a local string or 'Never' if null.

methods.name: getStatusText
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the current reload status.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns a color string representing the current reload status for UI indication.
